notes.title: Winter Update (1.2.1, Dec 27th 2021)
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b]Speed Mazers[/b]!

Winter season has come to Speed Mazing too! Enjoy brand new stage - the [b]Frozen Pond[/b]. But that's not the only new thing coming today!
Here's a full list of changes:
- New [b]Frozen Pond[/b] stage for all VS modes.
- [b]Funtastic Plastic[/b] and [b]Magic Cavern[/b] added to 4P VS mode.
- 40 new maps for 2P mode and 110 new maps for 4P mode (yup, that's a total of 150 new stages).
- Improved handling of reconnection of the controllers.

Please enjoy this new content! And if you've been waiting for a good time to get [b]Speed Mazing[/b] - now is the best time, as we're having a Winter Sale!

notes.title: Bots have invaded Speed Mazing's labyrinths!
notes.content:
Dear Players! our first content update to [i]Speed Mazing[/i] brings [b]Bots[/b] onboard! Now you can play Versus Mode against AI controlled characters! Setup is very easy - in the "Players Select" screen you will find a new option - "Add a Bot" (activated with C on the Keyboard or Y on an XBox type gamepad). You can add up to three bots. When Player #1 is selected (character and difficulty level), you'll be able to setup each bot by choosing a character and difficulty level. Unlike with human players, here the "Difficulty" actually means that the bot will be more difficult to beat - use it wisely ;)

Other changes/improvements are:
1. Changing the total number of difficulty levels from 7 to 5. Range stays the same, but each increase should be slightly more noticable.
2. Controls hint has been added to main menu - available upon pressing/holding "Ctrl" key, or "X" on an Xbox type gamepad.

Please take a moment to test yourself agains these bots and, of course, all feedback is welcome! Keep an eye out for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes (version 1.0.4, Oct 27, 2021)
notes.content:
Hello, dear Speed Mazing players!

Last few days were a bit intensive, as we were hunting an elusive error preventing some of you from moving the characters in the game. With a tremendous help from [b]⚡ChenZshuo⚡[/b] ( https://steamcommunity.com/id/chenzs2324 ) we were able to hunt that bug down. As it turned out - it affected some high refresh G-Sync displays with V-Sync turned off in the driver settings. The problem should now be fixed, so you should all be able to enjoy Speed Mazing with your friends and loved ones.
There was also a small change in German localization, as suggested by [b]P4InKiLLeR[/b] ( https://steamcommunity.com/id/P4InKiLLeR_GER ) - Vielen Dank!

We hope you're all having good time with Speed Mazing! Don't be affraid to visit our community or leave us a review!
